subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the plaza in front of the Cathedral

101210101.text: Ah, you've finally arrived. There's no time to spare, so we'll begin with our first lesson...

101210102.text: Wait, hold on! There's something we need to clear up first, otherwise it'll keep bugging us!

101210105.text: *sigh* So that's still on your mind, huh? Maybe you're the ones who can't let things go.

101210106.text: Don't worry, there's a time and place for exacting vengeance. Besides, I'm not in the mood for any right now, best save it for later.

101210107.text: Uh... you need to be in the right "mood" for vengeance?

101210108.text: I already have a long list of vengeance to exact. Even if I wanted to begin now, I'd have to start in the right order.

101210109.text: Who knows how long it will be before I get to you.

101210110.text: Hehe, well... if you have so much to take care of, wouldn't it just be easier to give us a clean slate?

101210111.text: Absolutely not! Stealing my targets, calling me a "ruthless ruler," and suspecting my uncle... all worthy of vengeance in my eyes!

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Eula
Talk to the locals and observe Eula's demonstration

101210201.text: Oh... you're Eula of the Lawrence Clan, right? This can't be good...

101210202.text: Ahem! You there, lowly laborer. You stand in the presence of a member of the illustrious Lawrence Clan. I have words for you.

101210203.text: Please acknowledge the glory bestowed upon thee by the nobility, uhh... what comes next...? Oh, right! By solemnly kneeling to the ground with utmost sincerity.

101210205.text: Huh? I can't make heads or tails of anything you're saying!

101210206.text: *sigh* Hold on, what did they always teach me...?

101210207.text: "Whenever a dispute arises, protection of your family's prestige and dignity always takes precedence."

101210208.text: Got it. Ahem! As a lowly commoner, you shall maintain absolute reverence when speaking with those under which you so graciously toil. How dare you speak in such a manner?

101210209.text: Ugh, is everyone from the Lawrence Clan so strange?

101210210.text: The days of the Lawrence Clan's tyranny have long passed. I don't care what you're trying to do, just beat it.

101210213.text: Like I said, I don't care what you're doing. I have nothing to say to any member of the Lawrence Clan.

101210214.text: And here's a word of advice... I wouldn't be caught dead walking too closely with any one of their like in Mondstadt.

101210215.text: If that's all, I'll be going. I'm afraid I won't be able to control myself if we talk any longer.

101210216.text: Hey — hey! Don't leave! Halt! Ugh, mark my words, vengeance will be mine!

101210217.text: Wow... the Lawrence name really does carry a terrible reputation.

101210218.text: Never mind him, I could have predicted as much. Let's find someone else.

subQuests.subQuestName: Continue talking to the locals

101210301.text: Ahem! You there, lowly toiler. You stand in the presence of a member of the illustrious Lawrence Clan. I have words for you.

101210302.text: Please acknowledge the glory bestowed upon thee by the nobility, and solemnly kneel to the ground with utmost sincerity.

101210304.text: Huh? Why don't you respond? According to the custom, I must wait until you kneel completely before I can say the next words.

101210305.text: Ah, right! I mustn't look at you too long, or I'll be drawing more attention to our difference in status... Oh dear, I've already stared at you for quite a while.

101210307.text: Fine, you may spare yourself the formality of kneeling, as it may be a little inconvenient. I shall continue... Oh, wait, I think there's a line for people with rude attitudes in this situation...

101210308.text: Hey! Stop bothering me, or else I might say something you wouldn't like to hear!

101210309.text: Then again, I've got no words for anyone from the Lawrence Clan.

101210313.text: Yes, I don't think his attitude will change. If I keep grandstanding like this, the outcome won't be good. Let's try to find someone else to talk to.

101210314.text: Hmph! I'll remember your unwillingness to comply! Mark my words, vengeance will be mine!

subQuests.subQuestName: Continue talking to the locals

101210402.text: Yeah, I've already heard it all before. Look, just spare me the time, our answer is always the same. We've got nothing to say to the likes of you.

101210403.text: I mean, seriously, can't you just take a hint?

101210404.text: Please calm down, we don't want to cause any trouble.

101210405.text: *sigh* I know she's a Knight of Favonius, and that the Knights wouldn't misplace their trust, but the name Lawrence carries too much weight with it.

101210406.text: Even to this very day, the descendants of the Lawrence Clan are still scheming to reclaim Mondstadt and reinstate their aristocratic rule.

101210407.text: And if that wasn't enough, here you are purposefully using their awkward way of speaking just to put on an act? Don't you care for the feelings of us ordinary folk?

101210409.text: But mark my words, this transgression will not go unnoticed!

101210410.text: H—Huh? You wanna fight? Listen here, I might be no match for you, but I'll be sure to lodge a complaint with the Knights of Favonius!

101210413.text: I'm sorry but... I want her to understand that I'm serious!

101210414.text: Listen here, if you don't want things to get more unpleasant, then you'd better just stop.

101210415.text: Forget it, there's no point in quarreling any further. Let's go.

101210417.text: It's alright, this happens quite often. Let's find someone else to talk to.

101210418.text: Uh, Paimon thinks we've seen enough now. Let's just stop.

101210419.text: Actually, Paimon thinks we should apologize for asking you to demonstrate for us. We had no idea the feelings between the Lawrence Clan and the people of Mondstadt were so bitter.

101210420.text: Haha, what can we do? The Lawrence name is already a dirty word among every household in Mondstadt. Even three-year-olds know the story. I see this kind of attitude all the time.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Dragonspine for aristocratic conduct training

101210601.text: Not bad. A lot better than I had anticipated, at least.

101210602.text: *panting* Paimon almost didn't make it through! Whew, good thing we didn't get stuck.

101210604.text: Don't flatter yourselves. We've only just begun.

101210605.text: This scenario was relatively simple. In the face of a real battle, one would seldom have a chance to stop and evaluate the situation.

101210606.text: There's a Ley Line Monolith just up ahead that will attract nearby monsters.

101210607.text: True elegance is the ability to calmly yet swiftly make decisions in the heat of battle.

101210610.text: My family set only the highest expectations for me, even as a child.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Eula to learn how the training will proceed

101210501.text: It's s—so c—cold... Does aristocrat training really need to be done here?

101210502.text: If you wish to truly achieve the dignified conduct of an aristocrat, you must learn to remain composed and elegant even amidst harsh conditions.

101210503.text: For example, you can see that part of the path up ahead is quite difficult to traverse.

101210504.text: But a well-trained aristocrat would not only effortlessly proceed forward, but do so without a stain on their garment and their elegance fully intact.

101210505.text: Paimon thinks we've left the realm of aristocrats and entered the realm of adventuring.

101210506.text: #Compared to what we've already seen, {NICKNAME}, this should be a piece of cake.

101210508.text: Uh-huh, this is where you can finally apply some of your adventuring knowledge.

101210511.text: Haha, you look pretty confident this time.

101210512.text: Alright, let's get started. Remember, you must be graceful and elegant. Don't get knocked or launched into the air, that would be most unsightly.

101210510.text: Paimon thinks so too... But you've got this in the bag!

subQuests.subQuestName: Reach the objective without being launched or taking any damage
Reach the objective without being launched or taking any damage
Reach the destination without being launched or taking any damage
Talk to Eula

101211801.text: So it seems you've finally given up on the idea of finding more people to talk to.

101211802.text: Believe me, that's in everyone's best interest.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the training location and activate the Ley Line Monolith

101211001.text: Listen, I have no idea what she's trying to do... But trust me, you two should just keep away from her.

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat the opponents without being launched or Frozen

101211101.text: It'll be difficult at first, but the key is to remain patient. Let's try again.

101211102.text: Remember, you must be elegant... Don't get knocked or launched into the air.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Eula

101210701.text: Well done. Your performance was most impressive.

101210702.text: And you managed to remain calm even in these grueling Dragonspine surroundings, haha. I'm starting to wonder if even I could have done the same.

101210703.text: Given such an outstanding performance, it seems there is little left for me to teach you.

101210704.text: Like Paimon said, adventuring is our specialty!

101210705.text: Hehe... So that's it for our training, right? Then let's get out of Dragonspine before Paimon turns into a popsicle! *shivers*

101210706.text: #Hold on. I was commending {NICKNAME}'s performance just now. You, on the other hand, seem to have made no progress at all!

101210707.text: What? You mean, Paimon was also part of the training!?

101210708.text: Yes, of course. You were frantically flying and dashing about throughout the entire thing. Not an elegant sight at all.

101210709.text: Did you even listen to anything I was trying to teach you?

101210711.text: Yeah, that's it, it's too cold here. B—Besides, Paimon was paying attention to the Traveler.

101210714.text: Whatever the reason, not heeding my instructions... a cause for vengeance, perhaps...

101210716.text: Huh? What is it? *gasp* Are you trying to poison Paimon!?

101210718.text: Didn't you just say that you were freezing? Drink it and it'll help warm you up.

101210719.text: Oh... uh... thank you! Um, are you... still planning on the whole vengeance thing?

101210720.text: If I wasn't, then why would I care about you being cold? If you turned into a Paimon popsicle, that would ruin my plans for vengeance now, wouldn't it...

101210721.text: So, "dear friend"... don't die on me out here.

101210722.text: Ahh! Paimon knew something was off!

101210713.text: Hey, that's not true! Paimon was just focusing on you the whole time!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Good Hunter to get a greeting gift
Talk to Eula and Amber

101210801.text: Oh, hey Eula! I see you've met the Honorary Knight!

101210802.text: We meet again, Amber! Seems we're just bound to run into you these days.

101210803.text: Well, I just got back and was thinking about grabbing a bite at Good Hunter. But now that you're here, why don't we all eat together?

101210804.text: Very well. It's been some time since we've last shared a meal together.

101210805.text: Come, take a seat. We can discuss my uncle's gift while we eat.

101210806.text: Yes, is there something else you'd like to order?

101210807.text: Could you please prepare a serving of my uncle's favorite, Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut? We'll take it as a gift to him later.

101210808.text: Coming right up! It'll take some time to prepare, I'll have it here at the counter once it's ready.

101210809.text: Hold on a moment. Is this Satisfying Salad also something that Amber ordered?

101210810.text: No, she didn't order it. But because she didn't order any vegetables, I thought I'd throw in a salad on the house. You know, to contrast all the meat dishes.

101210811.text: So... we clearly didn't order this, yet you prepared it without authorization... Hmph! Mark my words, this transgression will not go unnoticed!

101210812.text: Uh... you're going to take revenge on her for giving us a free salad!?

101210813.text: Hmph, you should know me by now, that's the kind of villainous character I am!

101210814.text: Well then... please wait a moment while I get the dish for your uncle started.

101210815.text: Hmph, delicious unauthorized delicacies... Sara will pay for this.

101210816.text: Why would you choose Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut as a gift for your uncle? Paimon's never even heard of that dish before...

101210817.text: This dish isn't actually on Good Hunter's menu. Only longstanding patrons such as my uncle would know about the dish. The old aristocrats seem to take a liking to it.

101210818.text: Because of the sour flavor of the sauerkraut, not too many people are fond of it these days. I guess it's become less popular over time.

101210819.text: Eula treated me to the dish once, and I couldn't even finish a bite. I've nicknamed it "Gebratenes Fleisch mit Vengeance" ever since. Yuck!

101210820.text: I never expected us to have such completely different tastes in food... If I weren't in such a good mood, I'd say that constitutes grounds for transgression...

101210821.text: Huh, so even Amber doesn't escape your vengeance?

101210822.text: Of course not! It's hard to find someone in Mondstadt that attracts contempt as much as she does.

101210823.text: Haha, it's fine when you're just joking between us, but I'm afraid our Honorary Knight might misunderstand you.

101210824.text: Eula's always talking about vengeance, but that's just how she is. It's nothing you should take too seriously.

101210825.text: But I am serious! And I'll remember every transgression committed against me! Ugh, it's no wonder so many people dislike you!

101210826.text: Paimon's starting to realize that Eula is actually a very good person.

101210827.text: There's no need to be so awkward when you want to say something nice.

101210828.text: *sigh* Listen, you've never been labeled as a social pariah, have you?

101210830.text: So that's why you wouldn't understand how hard it is for a bad person to try to be good. It's impossible for me, and I have no intention of acting like a good person.

101210831.text: Alright, no need to look so sullen... I'm just kidding. Come on, let's eat. The food is getting cold.

101210832.text: Ooh, I'm stuffed. I'll see Sara about the bill.

101210833.text: No need, I've left the Mora under the plate. If you try to settle it with her in person, she won't accept payment for the salad.

101210834.text: Don't underestimate my ability to exact revenge. Hah! Sara won't get the upper hand this time!

101210835.text: Alright, next you should pay my uncle a visit. He has a small camp at the top of the mountain near Springvale. He usually whiles his time away there when there's nothing else to do.

101210836.text: Uh... Aren't you coming with us, Eula?

101210837.text: I'm afraid that wouldn't be very convenient for me. It'd be better if you two went alone.

101210838.text: Ah yes, please do remember to pick up the dish from Sara.

101210839.text: I still have more recon to do in the wilderness. Well, until next time!

101210840.text: Let's meet again. What an interesting bunch you are.

subQuests.subQuestName: Get a Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut from Sara

101210901.text: Here, the Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut is ready to go! Be sure to eat it while it's hot, otherwise the flavor will be spoiled.

101210902.text: And by the way, don't worry too much when Eula says strange things. She's actually a very good person.

101210903.text: Paimon's been meaning to ask... No one could stand the sight of Eula when she was trying to speak with the others in Mondstadt earlier.

101210904.text: But she seemed to get along fine with you and Amber just now... what's up with that?

101210905.text: The people of Mondstadt don't take kindly to anyone bearing the Lawrence name.

101210906.text: They are unable to see past her family, therefore they don't actually see Eula for herself.

101210907.text: So no matter what Eula tries to do, it's seen as a wrongdoing. It essentially strips the meaning of anything she tries to accomplish.

101210910.text: How come you're able to see Eula differently then?

101210911.text: Well, when she joined the Knights of Favonius, it caused quite an uproar.

101210912.text: Many people signed a petition, demanding that the Knights reverse their decision.

101210913.text: At the same time, numerous members of the Lawrence Clan crowded the entrance of the Knights of Favonius Headquarters, clamoring for Eula to give an explanation.

101210914.text: Whoa... so both sides were unhappy.

101210915.text: That's right. So, you can imagine how determined Eula must have been under such circumstances.

101210916.text: But thanks to Grand Master Varka and the unwavering attitudes of others in the Knights of Favonius, they were able to quell the unrest. Tensions still remain beneath the surface, I'm afraid.

101210917.text: In the eyes of the people, she's a stain on the Knights of Favonius... and in the eyes of the Lawrence Clan, she's a disgrace to her family.

101210918.text: But she simply fulfills her duty as a Knight, silently helping one person after another, myself included.

101210919.text: People like Eula should be approached with care and understanding. She could stand to be treated a little more fairly.

subQuests.subQuestName: Additional

101209907.text: Uh... Paimon's confused... This girl's all "vengeance this" and "revenge that," but she doesn't seem the least bit angry...

101209908.text: Still, Paimon has met bigger weirdos before...

subQuests.subQuestName: Additional

101211201.text: Good luck! Just remember, don't get knocked or launched into the air. That would be most inelegant.

subQuests.subQuestName: Additional

101219901.text: That won't do! You've exposed your shortcomings.

101219902.text: No need to worry. Head back to the starting point and try again.

101219903.text: This is the Ley Line Monolith. Go ahead, activate it.

101219904.text: But be careful not to get launched into the air or frozen while fighting. That would be most unsightly.

101219905.text: That won't do! You've exposed your shortcomings.

101219906.text: No need to worry. Head back to the starting point and try again.

101219907.text: You failed this time, what a shame.

101219908.text: But not to worry, it's just training after all. Let's try again.
